DEEP LEARNING · COMPUTER VISIONMAR 2025

Music Recommendation System Based on Human Emotions

Developed an emotion-based music recommendation system using facial expression recognition. The system analyzes facial images, classifies emotions, and recommends personalized music playlists.

  • Recognizes Happy, Sad, Angry, and Neutral emotions.
  • Uses a deep learning model to classify facial expressions.
  • Allows users to select and play songs from recommended playlists.
